manifest.title: Happy Birthday! 生日与庆祝专项测验
manifest.subject: english

units.name: 专项测验
units.title: Happy Birthday! 生日与庆祝专项测验
units.desc: 针对人教版2024新教材七年级上册 Unit 7 Happy Birthday! 的高难度变式测验，覆盖生日与庆祝活动词汇、序数词、Wh- 疑问句复习，以及关于生日庆祝的跨文化阅读语篇。

exercises.question:
— When is your birthday?
— It's on October ______. It's the ______ day of October.
exercises.explanation: 日期表达用序数词缩写 1st，读作 first。第二空表示“十月第一天”，也用序数词 first。易错点：误写 1th 或混淆基数词 one 与序数词 first。

exercises.question:
用括号中所给词的序数词形式填空。
My birthday is on June ______ (3). December is the ______ (12) month of the year.
exercises.explanation: 3 的序数词是 third；12 的序数词是 twelfth，注意 ve 变为 f 再加 th。易错点：拼写错误，如 thirth 或 twelveth。

exercises.question:
— ______ do you celebrate your birthday?
— I usually have a party with my friends.
exercises.explanation: 答语 I usually have a party with my friends. 回答的是庆祝方式，因此问句用 How。A 询问活动内容，C 询问时间，D 询问地点。易错点：混淆 How 和 What 的提问功能。

exercises.question: 在句子 'My birthday is on May 1st.' 中，'May' 和 '1st' 通常需要重读。
exercises.explanation: 在英语句子中，实词通常重读。May 和 1st 承载关键信息，需要重读。故本题正确。考察句子重音与生日日期表达。

exercises.question:
根据答语补全问句，每空一词。
— ______ ______ your birthday?
— It's on February 3rd.
exercises.explanation: 答语 It's on February 3rd. 回答的是日期，因此问句用 When is your birthday?。易错点：误用 What time，因为 What time 询问具体钟点。

exercises.question:
阅读 Emma 的生日帖子，判断下列句子是否正确，正确写 T，错误写 F。
Hi! I'm Emma from Canada. My birthday is on November 8th. I usually have a party with my family. My mother makes a big cake. I make a wish and blow out the candles. My friends give me presents and cards. We sing songs and play games. I am very happy on my birthday.
(1) Emma's birthday is on November 18th. (2) Emma's mother makes a big cake. (3) Emma's friends give her presents and cards. (4) Emma doesn't like her birthday.
exercises.explanation: 由 My birthday is on November 8th. 可知(1)F；由 My mother makes a big cake. 可知(2)T；由 My friends give me presents and cards. 可知(3)T；由 I am very happy on my birthday. 可知(4)F。考察阅读细节提取与情感推断。

options: B. To talk about how she celebrates her birthday.
C. To ask for birthday presents.
D. To show her mother's cake.
exercises.question: What is Emma's main purpose in writing this text?
exercises.explanation: 文章围绕生日日期、庆祝方式、礼物和感受展开，主要目的是介绍自己如何庆祝生日。A、C、D 均偏离主旨。考察阅读主旨与写作意图推断。

options: B. How do you celebrate your birthday?
C. What do you do on your birthday?
D. Do you have a birthday party?
E. Where do you have the party?
exercises.question:
Choose TWO correct sentences to complete the dialogue.
— Hi, Jack. 1. ______
— It's on February 3rd.
— 2. ______
— I usually have a party with my friends.
exercises.explanation: 第一空：根据答语 It's on February 3rd. 可知，问句询问生日日期，A 符合；第二空：根据答语 I usually have a party with my friends. 可知，问句询问庆祝方式，B 符合。C 询问具体活动，D 是一般疑问句，E 询问地点。考察 Wh- 疑问句与生日交际语境的综合。

exercises.question:
找出并改正下列句子中的错误。
My birthday is on May 1th. I usually have a party and my friends give me many present.
exercises.explanation: 1 的序数词缩写是 1st，不是 1th；many 后接可数名词复数，present 应变为 presents。考察序数词缩写与名词复数的综合。

exercises.question:
阅读短文，用适当的词填空。
My name is Peter. My birthday is ______ (1) October 15th. I usually have a party ______ (2) my family. My mother makes a big cake. I make a wish and ______ (3) out the candles. I am very happy.
exercises.explanation: 具体日期前用介词 on；和……一起用 with；吹灭蜡烛是 blow out candles，情态动词后或并列动词用原形 blow。考察生日活动词汇与介词搭配。
